plugin_desc: SNMP monitoring template for Polycom voice gateway. It reports uptime, CPU utilization, memory utilization, and interface traffic, for RealPresence DMA (enterprise PEN 13885).
name: VoiceGateway

metrics.name: cpu_usage_percent
metrics.description: CPU utilization of each Polycom RealPresence DMA server (POLYCOM-DMA stRsrcCPUUsageCPUUtilizationPct under IANA PEN 13885), reported directly as a 0-100 percentage. The query takes the maximum across servers so the hottest DMA node is visible. Sustained high CPU usage can indicate call-control or conference-resource pressure.

metrics.name: memory_used
metrics.description: Bytes currently in use by Polycom RealPresence DMA server memory (POLYCOM-DMA stRsrcMemUsageUsed under IANA PEN 13885). The device reports megabytes; the query scales to bytes. Together with total memory it determines utilization.

metrics.name: memory_total
metrics.description: Total Polycom RealPresence DMA server memory in bytes (POLYCOM-DMA stRsrcMemUsageTotalMemory under IANA PEN 13885, reported in megabytes and scaled to bytes). Together with used memory it determines utilization.

metrics.name: memory_free
metrics.description: Optional free Polycom RealPresence DMA server memory in bytes (POLYCOM-DMA stRsrcMemUsageFree under IANA PEN 13885, reported in megabytes and scaled to bytes). Some DMA software revisions omit this column.

metrics.name: memory_usage_percent
metrics.description: Memory utilization of Polycom RealPresence DMA servers, computed as used / total * 100 from stRsrcMemUsageUsed and stRsrcMemUsageTotalMemory. High memory usage may indicate session or conference-resource pressure.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCInOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes received over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCInOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCOutOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes sent over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCOutOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.
